subject: Follow-up: IAM evidence and vendor QA for NovaMed evaluation
messages:
From: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa.nguyen@novamed.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Security Team <security@novamed.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: initial QA items (SOC2, SSO/SCIM, RBAC)

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the demo this morning — the team found the latency/throughput discussion really helpful. As we start our security review, a few quick asks from our side so we can get procurement moving:

- Current SOC 2 status and date of most recent opinion (or SOC 2 report snapshot)
- GDPR/HIPAA posture and whether Redwood operates as a processor for PHI under your terms
- Vendor security questionnaire initiation — attached is our QA form (Vendor_QA_Form_NovaMed.docx)
- Identity & Access specifics: SSO/SAML setup docs, SCIM provisioning support, RBAC overview and admin controls

Can you confirm who on your side will own the evidence collection and whether you can provide an IAM evidence pack or template? Our target is to complete the security review by Aug 13 so procurement can finalize terms.

Appreciate it — I can set up a shared folder and an initial kickoff call if helpful.

Best,
Alyssa Nguyen
Director, IT Security
NovaMed Health

Attachment: Vendor_QA_Form_NovaMed.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa.nguyen@novamed.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: initial QA items (SOC2, SSO/SCIM, RBAC)

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the clear list and for sending the QA form. Short answers up front:

- SOC 2: Type II, most recent audit completed Mar 2027; summary attached (Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf). We can share the full report under an NDA — we have a standard MSA addendum for redaction if needed.
- GDPR/HIPAA: Redwood supports customers processing PHI and offers a Business Associate Addendum (BAA) for HIPAA. We act as a processor. We also have data residency options by region; happy to confirm specifics for NovaMed's preferred region.
- IAM: We support SAML 2.0 SSO, SCIM 2.0 provisioning (user/group sync), RBAC with delegated admin roles, and audit logs for privileged actions.

Next steps I propose:
1) I will attach an IAM evidence template (spreadsheet) that lists the specific artifacts our security team can produce (config screenshots, policy excerpts, audit log extracts).
2) Please complete the Vendor_QA_Form where items require a vendor signature; we'll respond inline to technical/controls questions.
3) Monica (cc'd) will be your intake lead for evidence collection — she will coordinate access to sample configs and redact as needed.
4) If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min call with our security engineer to walk through SCIM mapping and RBAC scoping.

I've attached the IAM template and the SOC2 summary. Monica — can you pick this up tomorrow and start populating items we can share by EOD Tue? Grace — looping you so you're aware of the ask and timeline for the deal team.

Alyssa — does Aug 4 at 10:00am PT work for a walkthrough? If not, propose two slots.

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_IAM_Evidence_Template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: NovaMed intake — owner + quick plan

Monica / Grace — quick internal plan for RDW-4521 (NovaMed security intake):

1) Owner: Monica — lead intake and populate the IAM template. Target: initial package ready by EOD Tue (2027-08-03).
2) Artifacts to prioritize (minimal set to unblock procurement):
   - SOC 2 summary + plan for full report under NDA (attached)
   - SAML metadata export and an example SP/IdP config screenshot
   - SCIM sample provisioning payload and confirmation of supported attributes
   - RBAC matrix document showing role names, permissions, and admin escalation flow
   - Audit log extract for an admin-facing action (last 30 days), sanitized
3) Redaction: identify any customer-specific data and propose redaction approach before sharing full logs.
4) Call: provisionally schedule 30-min walkthrough on Aug 4 10:00am PT — confirm after Alyssa replies.

Monica: please use the Drive link in the HubSpot ticket and drop artifacts there. Flag anything that requires engineering/security assistance and I'll escalate.

Thanks — Vivek
From: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa.nguyen@novamed.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Security Team <security@novamed.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: initial QA items (SOC2, SSO/SCIM, RBAC)

Vivek / Monica — thanks for the prompt response and the attachments. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

- BAA: NovaMed will need a BAA in order to move forward; procurement will request a template during contracting.
- Scope: this review covers PHI handled in the hosted Redwood environment; please note any differences if the deployment were Dedicated or Private.
- Vendor QA form: our Security team will complete the doc and mark vendor-responsible items. Expect the completed form back by Wed EOD.

Aug 4 10:00am PT works for a walkthrough — please send a calendar invite and a video link. Monica, when you drop the artifacts into the shared folder, put a short readme with filenames and redaction notes so our team can consume quickly.

Appreciate it — Alyssa
